Multiple CSS selectors each exclude their matched elements

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<body><nav class=\"nav\">Menu</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer></body>", "{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".nav\",\"footer\"]}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
